Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We're reaching out to propose a collaborative Instagram post that builds on your recent campaign around the Direct Trade model. You mentioned that Stumptown Coffee Roasters has a commitment to honoring their Direct Trade relationships, paying quality premiums for their coffees, and creating multi-year commitments to their producers [P9]. This post would highlight that dedication and the impact it has on the coffee-making process, showcasing the value of your partnership with Stumptown Coffee Roasters. It would also invite your team to share a moment of connection with your customers, further deepening their experience at your cafes [P5]. The post would focus on the emotional aspect of the partnership, emphasizing the value of the relationships and the commitment to quality. It would be a way to reinforce your dedication to the Direct Trade model and the positive impact it has on the industry [P6].
